message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short Interest Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of monthly short interest (shares short / shares outstanding) over the past 12 months.", "rationale": "High volatility in short interest may signal disagreement or uncertainty among informed traders, with extreme changes possibly indicating mispricings.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high short interest volatility"}, {"name": "Patent Application Intensity", "construction": "Number of patent applications filed in the past fiscal year divided by total assets at fiscal year end (data from USPTO filings matched to Compustat firm identifiers).", "rationale": "Firms aggressively investing in innovation may have higher future growth opportunities not fully recognized by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high patent application intensity"}, {"name": "SG&A Efficiency Ratio", "construction": "Change in (annual SG&A expense divided by annual revenue) over the prior three fiscal years.", "rationale": "Improving efficiency in selling, general, and administrative expenses may signal better management quality and future profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with large declines (improvements) in the SG&A Efficiency Ratio"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Risk", "construction": "Ratio of cost of goods sold to purchases from the largest supplier, where supplier info is sourced from 10-K filings or FactSet Supply Chain data.", "rationale": "Firms highly dependent on a single supplier may face greater operational risk and higher risk premia.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high supplier concentration risk"}, {"name": "Option-Implied Skewness", "construction": "Skewness of risk-neutral return distribution derived from contemporaneous option prices (using OTM puts and calls, 1-month maturity).", "rationale": "Investors may demand higher returns for stocks with negatively skewed expected return distributions.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with more negative option-implied skewness"}, {"name": "Dividend Smoothing Deviation", "construction": "Absolute value of the difference between change in annual dividend per share and change in annual earnings per share over the last 3 years.", "rationale": "Firms that pay dividends inconsistent with earnings changes may signal information asymmetry or agency problems, potentially leading to mispricings.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with large dividend smoothing deviations"}, {"name": "Earnings Call Language Tone Shift", "construction": "Change in management tone score (proxied by positive minus negative word frequency in quarterly earnings call transcripts) over the last 4 quarters.", "rationale": "A sharp positive shift in management tone may indicate forthcoming good news not yet incorporated into prices.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with large positive tone shifts"}, {"name": "Revenue Geographical Diversification", "construction": "Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) of revenue by geographic segment (computed from segment disclosures in 10-Ks), multiplied by -1 so that higher values indicate more diversification.", "rationale": "Geographically diversified firms may be less exposed to local shocks, so investors might underprice this risk mitigation.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high geographical revenue diversification"}, {"name": "Board Gender Diversity Change", "construction": "Change in the percentage of female board members over the past 2 years (from BoardEx or company proxy statements).", "rationale": "Increasing gender diversity may signal improving governance and broader perspectives, possibly enhancing long-term firm value.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with large recent increases in board gender diversity"}, {"name": "Late-Reported Earnings Penalty", "construction": "Number of days between fiscal period end and actual 10-K/10-Q filing date minus industry median, measured each quarter.", "rationale": "Firms that report earnings later than peers may have greater opacity or internal problems, requiring a risk premium.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with longer-than-median reporting lags"}]}
